components.name: Rigel Ba
components.label: Ba
components.note: Individual stellar member from MSC WDS 05145-0812. The MSC BC sky direction and primary Rigel parallax place the component approximately at J2000; Ba/Bb/C share that BC direction and the primary proper motion. No resolved inner orbital offset, phase or individual radial velocity is adopted. B/BC integrated photometry and catalogue estimated masses are withheld. Individual Johnson V and physical measurements are unknown.
